commands.command:
sudo -n tee /usr/local/sbin/zram-swap >/dev/null <<'ANTRIEB_ZRAM_SCRIPT'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
DEVICE=/dev/zram0
SIZE_BYTES=536870912
PRIORITY=100
case "${1:-}" in
  start)
    /sbin/modprobe zram num_devices=1
    if grep -q "^$DEVICE " /proc/swaps; then
      exit 0
    fi
    if [ "$(cat /sys/block/zram0/disksize)" != "0" ]; then
      printf '1\n' > /sys/block/zram0/reset
    fi
    printf '%s\n' "$SIZE_BYTES" > /sys/block/zram0/disksize
    /sbin/mkswap -f "$DEVICE" >/dev/null
    /sbin/swapon -p "$PRIORITY" "$DEVICE"
    ;;
  stop)
    if grep -q "^$DEVICE " /proc/swaps; then
      /sbin/swapoff "$DEVICE"
    fi
    if [ -e /sys/block/zram0/reset ]; then
      printf '1\n' > /sys/block/zram0/reset
    fi
    ;;
  *)
    printf 'usage: %s {start|stop}\n' "$0" >&2
    exit 2
    ;;
esac
ANTRIEB_ZRAM_SCRIPT
sudo -n chmod 0755 /usr/local/sbin/zram-swap
sudo -n ls -l /usr/local/sbin/zram-swap

sudo -n tee /etc/systemd/system/zram-swap.service >/dev/null <<'ANTRIEB_ZRAM_UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=Compressed in-memory swap on zram
Documentation=man:swapon(8)
Before=swap.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
RemainAfterExit=yes
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/zram-swap start
ExecStop=/usr/local/sbin/zram-swap stop

[Install]
WantedBy=swap.target
ANTRIEB_ZRAM_UNIT
sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload
sudo -n systemctl enable zram-swap.service
sudo -n systemctl start zram-swap.service
